column1: # binary<TAB>CI seconds: tests kept in one shard because they overlap when run together.

# Weighed by ci/shard.sh's REFIT RULE step 3, at the block's worst in-process wall time on CI (libtest's `finished in`) over runs 43570762262, 43573333731, 43574423322, 43575564961.

# re-weighed as their Furnace wall time in the pinned image (530 s, 179 s) times 1.7, the CI-to-Furnace ratio of one verify: estimates until the refit rule's measurement.
